case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You pointed to the alloy surcharge and the cost of your material. Option B answers that directly: with the index clause on the alloy surcharge, we carry the movement above the deadband, so the base price needs no risk premium.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar steel prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.92; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your group a longer contract term and a clean structure without an index clause, and the price reflects the cost movements above. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since you will likely need approval on your side, here is a short paragraph for the person who decides: Option A gives Edelstahl-Service Donautal a firm contract term with us, a fixed unit price with no index mechanism to administer, and a clear basis for planning. Could you please take Option A to that person? We are glad to provide anything the approval needs.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Your offer to explain your costs is welcome, and a breakdown would help us finalise this quickly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Building on your Option B, we propose a unit price of €5.63, which incorporates the extended payment terms and provides a stable framework for the extended contract duration. Our latest terms for this Angebot feature a price of €5.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

As to the index change data you cited, that is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. We have verified the index movements you cited; however, our AS-14404 requirements are covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning the recent decreases do not reduce our current cost basis. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. While company policy prevents us from sharing a detailed cost breakdown, we are pleased to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms by applying the AS-14404 index clause. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You asked for an index clause on the alloy surcharge, and all three options below contain one. We carry the movement above the deadband, so the base price needs no risk premium for alloy. We will not rely on the index movements you rejected, so we turn to price history and delivery.

On price history:
Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.07; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.00; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 3 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.04; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives you the longest payment term and the clause you asked for, at a unit price in line with our order history. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since you will need to take this further, here is a short paragraph for your decision-maker. It can be approved as it stands.

Could you please take Option A to the person who decides? If your pricing committee needs a summary or any other material, we are glad to provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Building on your Option C, we are prepared to reduce our unit price to €5.43, which brings it below your recent historical level. This offer secures the 60-day payment terms and 24-month contract duration you requested, alongside the index clause.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.38 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, a price of €5.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.43 per unit.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
